correctness.rationale: The two exterior segments run as independent rate-lambda birth fronts and the internal segment as a rate-2lambda birth front until completion, giving a maximum of three independent Erlang variables. Poisson-tail hazard monotonicity proves strictly decreasing log marginals and exact global allocation. The endpoint inequality reduces to a one-sign-change entire power series, giving the unique strict crossover; small-order and equality cases are explicit. A separate full CTMC uniformization verifier passes 10,835 finite assertions.

value.rationale: A natural finite-time contagion-coverage objective undergoes a sharp and unique topology-of-optima change with the deadline, for every path order at least five. The result gives an exact all-size optimal-source placement algorithm, complete equality cases, and a nontrivial transcendental threshold rather than a routine numeric gain. It is a benchmarking theorem, not an uncalibrated public-health policy claim.
